hey so we need to do a quick demo to understand how to do this painting on 3d right because the last guy cant comprehend how to do it correctly and its currently in a horrible state for the @cart/hmsc-int/editors/model/Studio.tsx 

here is what you need to do
make a quick demo file, put down a triangle in the center of a grid, and mask it, so that the grid is only shown on the triangle and no where else
resolution: Built cart/triangle_mask_demo.tsx — the smallest honest demo of 'paint a pattern onto a shape', the thing the Studio painter keeps getting wrong. It draws a grid pattern across the whole Effect quad (pure function of uv, blind to the shape) and an analytic equilateral-triangle SDF mask (inside=1/outside=0, AA'd via fwidth), then composes them with a single multiply: final = gridLine * inside. The grid therefore shows ON the triangle and nowhere else. Lesson encoded in the header: painting a face is NOT a CPU texel array dodging neighbours; it is pattern*mask in the fragment shader — swap the triangle SDF for a face's UV hull and you get correct bleed-free face painting, pixel-perfect at any zoom, ~30 lines of WGSL. Shipped + self-shot (PASS, /tmp/trimask.png) confirming the grid is clipped to the triangle.
